revision: 2 - planner art-review corrections (panel exposure + iris legibility)
execution_approach: Procedural bpy reconstruction via the Nous-approved Blender MCP in a live Blender 5.2.0 LTS session. Revision 2 corrected two blocking visual defects found in planner art review: (1) the six Protective_Panel_* meshes were rebuilt as closed solids with their outer face moved outward to radius 0.730 m (frame strips/rails at 0.738 m) so the warm off-white panel faces are visibly exposed around the cylinder while remaining nested just inside the equipment-grey frames; (2) the aperture depth stack was reordered so the front collar is an annulus (open centre) at r 0.330-0.385 with front face at Y=-1.110, a segmented Systems_Cyan ring sits at r 0.290-0.330 just inside it, the Charcoal shutter rim at r 0.260-0.290, six Equipment_Grey iris blades at r 0.133-0.263 in front of a small Charcoal backing disc (r 0.16, Y=-1.075) and the deep Charcoal backplate (r 0.34, Y=-1.060); the former solid Mechanical_Shutter_Rim cylinder that occluded the whole aperture was replaced by a thin annulus. Recess plates were darkened to Charcoal and vent slats lightened to Equipment_Grey so the upper chassis reads as a dark recess, not a glowing screen; only the small status bar, cap lamps and maintenance lamps use emissive materials. All meshes were positionally welded, normals recalculated, transforms applied, and the asset-only hierarchy exported to GLB with export_yup=True so the repo pipeline restores Z-up.
